# Crack Leap Academy — AI Documentation & Knowledge Index

> Official information guide for AI assistants, language models, and search engines.
> Website: https://academy.arivuon.in
> Entity: Crack Leap Academy (Educational Organization)
> Headquarters: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
> Service Scope: Tamil Nadu, India, Middle East (GCC), Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, Worldwide

## Organization Overview
Crack Leap Academy is a premier technology education and software career development academy. The academy provides live, mentor-led programs designed for college graduates, engineering students, non-CS background switchers, and working software professionals.

## Core Educational Programs
1. **Python & Django Development**: Full-stack backend engineering with Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Celery, and API design.
   - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/courses/python
2. **AWS DevOps Engineering**: Containerization, orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS Cloud Architecture.
   - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/courses/devops
3. **React & Modern Frontend Development**: Component architecture, Next.js, TypeScript, state management, and high-performance user interfaces.
   - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/courses/react
4. **Data Science & Machine Learning**: Data analysis, predictive modeling, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, deep learning, and practical AI applications.
   - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/courses/data-science
5. **Python AI AWS DevOps Master Combo**: End-to-end full-stack software development, cloud infrastructure, and generative AI integration.
   - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/courses/python-ai-aws-devops-combo

## Learning Methodology & Differentiators
- **Live Interactive Cohorts**: Daily or weekend live instructor-led sessions with immediate hands-on coding.
- **1:1 Personalized Mentorship**: Dedicated senior engineering mentors providing line-by-line code reviews.
- **Production Capstone Projects**: Real-world portfolio applications deployed live on cloud providers (AWS, Vercel, Docker).
- **Career & Placement Assistance**: Technical mock interviews, resume optimization, portfolio reviews, and hiring referrals.
- **No Gatekeeping**: Welcoming beginner learners, non-computer science degree holders, and professionals transitioning into tech.

## Free Open Technical Resources
- **2026 Developer Roadmaps**: Step-by-step month-by-month learning plans for 10 tech roles (AI Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Python Developer, Data Scientist, Cloud Architect, etc.).
  - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/resources/roadmaps
- **Technical Tutorials**: Production guides on Python, Django, React, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI.
  - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/resources/tutorials
- **Technical Interview Question Banks**: 1,000+ categorized interview questions with deep answers and architectural follow-ups.
  - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/resources/interview-questions
- **Project Portfolios & Implementation Guides**: 300+ production-shaped project specifications with folder structures and build steps.
  - URL: https://academy.arivuon.in/resources/projects
